title: source.journald
description: Tail systemd journal via journalctl -f -o json (subprocess).

units.description: Optional list of systemd units to filter (--unit=...). Empty = all units.

priority.description: syslog priority threshold (0=emerg ... 7=debug). Lower number = more severe. Default: 7 (all).

ip_field.description: Journal field to scan for the source IP. Default 'MESSAGE'. Use 'SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER' or any other field name.

ip_pattern.description: Optional regex with named capture (?P<ip>...) to extract the source IP. If omitted, the first IPv4/IPv6 substring is used.

since_boot.description: Replay entries since current boot before following. Default false = follow new entries only.

event_type.description: EventType to label emitted events. One of AuthFailure, AuthSuccess, HttpRequest, Http4xx, Http5xx, SmtpAuthFailure, PortAccess, ConnectionEvent, or Custom name.
